entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

O, m’Ewuradze, midze dase dɛ ɔwo abɔ me dɛ munhu Wo na monsom Wo. Midzi dase sesei dɛ mennyi ahoɔdzen biara na Ɔwodze Eyɛ Otumfo, midzi hia neminemi na Ɔwo Eyɛ ɔdzefo. Ewuradze, obiara nnyi hɔ kã wo ho, ɔhaw mu Ɔboafo, Ɔwo a Ɔwoara Etse W’ase.
